items.description: The capital of Entre Ríos province, overlooking the Paraná River, known for its river port and historic buildings.
A city on the Uruguay River, known for its citrus production and proximity to the Salto Grande dam.
Famous for its vibrant annual carnival, attracting thousands of visitors to Entre Ríos province.
A historic port city on the Uruguay River, featuring significant architectural landmarks and colonial history.
The capital of Formosa province, located on the Paraguay River, known for its tropical climate and subtropical setting.
A border city near Paraguay, serving as a significant trade and transit hub in the northern region.
The capital of Jujuy province, a high-altitude city surrounded by colorful Andean mountains and indigenous culture.
A key industrial city in Jujuy province, known for its sugar cane production and agricultural industry.
A city known for its historical iron and steel industrial activity in the Jujuy valley.
The capital city of La Pampa province, located in a vast plain area known for cattle ranching and agriculture.
